locations.label: Temple Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Collect the two ghostly Pack-a-Punch parts: one on a rail cart in Derailment and one on the plane wing in Spike. Return to the ghostly machine at Temple and install them. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Spike plane-wing part
locations.description: Collect the two ghostly Pack-a-Punch parts: one on a rail cart in Derailment and one on the plane wing in Spike. Return to the ghostly machine at Temple and install them. locations.label: Temple relic plinth
locations.description: Place the relic on the stone in front of Temple Pack-a-Punch. Watch the scene, then interact with the new nearby Dark Aether portal. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Mindfulness obelisk
locations.description: Dig around the Merchant Road obelisk until you find the red orb. Activate it and record the wall’s displayed symbols and their matching ground-rune landmarks before moving. Step on the matching runes in the displayed order. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Resilience shield / obelisk
locations.description: At Debris Field, shoot the three external Dark Aether crystal candidates until one releases the red orb. Follow it to the wall near the Decimator Shield. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Sacrifice torches / obelisk
locations.description: Get three Molotovs from Merchant Road West or crafting. At Derailment, light the three torches in quick succession so all remain lit together: the entry boxcar, the right side of Derailment and behind that second torch. The red orb appears near the third. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Final Kortifex portal
locations.description: Confirm Mindfulness, Resilience AND Sacrifice are complete. Refill ammo, repair armour and upgrade your damage weapon. Keep the Decimator for defense, then use the portal near Temple Pack-a-Punch when the squad is ready. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
